messages:
Leah Rivera: Quick async standup — SLO/alerts focus.
Leah Rivera: Yesterday: validated canary for kv-cache warmup (p95 down from 210ms -> 78ms after tweak). Rolled patch to autoscaler to prefer warm instances.
Devon Park: looks great. Any regressions in throughput?
Leah Rivera: No throughput regressions; seen slight increase in burst tail latency during cold starts. Root cause: race in evict loop when warmup flag flips.
Mika Chen: @Leah can you paste the small diff you applied? want to reference in runbook.
Leah Rivera: sure, diff: ```diff
- evict_if_idle()
+ evict_if_idle() // guard on warmup_in_progress
```
oncall-bot: ALERT 2333333200: high p95 latency on /v1/generate across us-west-2 (threshold > 300ms). Pager sent to @Devon Park.
Devon Park: acked the page, digging into routing. Early signal shows traffic routed to older model variant, causing slower kernels.
Leah Rivera: linked a quick query: prometheus -> `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le))` — p95 spiked to ~410ms at 23:06 UTC.
Mika Chen: I'm on logs — seeing kernel selection fallback to fp16 -> int8 path mismatch on node pool b. That node pool had a failed driver update earlier.
Devon Park: ramping traffic off pool-b to pool-a via routing override: `curl -X POST https://ops.redwood/api/route-override -d '{"pool":"pool-a","weight":1.0}'` — will monitor.
Leah Rivera: blocker: need a short blameless note for SLO incident timeline. I can draft if someone drops a quick timeline bullet.
Mika Chen: Timeline: 23:00 driver update on pool-b started; 23:04 driver update failed; 23:05 routing fallback to model-variant-old; 23:06 p95 spike; 23:08 auto-fallback kicked in; 23:12 routing override to pool-a.
Devon Park: +1 on Leah drafting the note. I'll add the metrics screenshots.
oncall-bot: RESOLVED 2333333500: latency back under threshold, alert closed.
Leah Rivera: Today: finish runbook edit to include driver update rollback steps, push the small evict guard to canary, and create a CR for autoscaler heuristics.
Devon Park: I'll follow up with a postmortem draft and assign owners for rollback test coverage.
Mika Chen: I'll create a quick monitor to detect driver update anomalies (compare kernel-version vs expected) and add it to the SRE playbook.
Leah Rivera: Blockers: need someone (Devon?) to approve the routing override KV so I can run the canary later this afternoon.
Devon Park: I'll approve by EOD. Anything else?
Mika Chen: None from me. :thumbsup:
Leah Rivera: Thanks all — ping me in thread if you need the diff or metrics. I'll post runbook link shortly: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-warmup-driver-update
